description: This PHP source file defines a Parser class within the Goteo\Util\Origins namespace. The class provides methods to analyze and extract information from HTTP request objects, specifically focusing on user-agent, referer, and URL sanitization. It integrates external libraries for user agent parsing and referer parsing, and includes logic for internal/external referer classification and handling subdomain relationships.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A utility class for analyzing HTTP request headers and URLs to determine UA info, referer info, and internal/external categorization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the parser with HTTP request data, host, and subdomains.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Static method to sanitize text by removing special characters and unsupported UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: getUA
methods.description: Extracts and returns user agent information via UAParser.

methods.name: getReferer
methods.description: Determines and returns information about the referer source, including handling internal links, subdomains, and special categories like email campaigns.
